reviews.title: That's The Way It Was "The Last Saint" Circumstance ?
reviews.body: Attended This Show And In Fact The First Six Of This Tour.A Honeymoon Excursion That Led To 31 Years And Counting Of Blessed Partnership And Love. The Show Started Out Hot With Jerry Playing Better Than The Earlier Shows Of The Tour. The Second Box Of Rain Of The Tour Finished A Nice Opening At The Break Things Got Crazy On The Floor, So We Went To The Jerry's Side And Went Up A Section And A Half Or So. Half Step Set The Pace For A Smokin' Set II. Man Smart,Woman Smarter Was Good Then A Heartfelt High Time And We Were Set For A Grate Set List. Then "Booby" Starts Lost Sailor (Listen For The Feedback Growl From Jerry Seconds Into It) I Don't Know What He Had In Mind But It Was Not Lost Sailor. Coupled With A Trite Vocal Delivery And Animated Hand Gestures From Bob. Jerry Began To Seethe We Were Just Over The Speakers 40-60 Feet Away. You Could See Him Grinding His Teeth During Bob's L'l Rap About 4 Minutes In. They Managed To Finish The Medley. We Didn't Know If It Was His Song Selection,The Delivery Or If Jerry Just Took The "Lost Sailor Rap Personally. But You Can Here The Discourse Of The Break Into Saint And Bob's "Wiss Swatch" Comment, Whatever The Reason They Finished It And Jerry Bolted. There In Front Of Our Eyes Bobby Approached Jerry As They Headed Backstage And Jerry Lit Into Him. I Thought For A Second It Was Gonna Come To Blows. I Think It Was Steve Parrish Who Intervened. They Disappeared Then Jerry Came Back Out And Sat Alone In A Little Aclove Of Speakers And Amps Hidden From Sight. Steve Came Out After A While Leaned Over And Said Something To Jerry Who Furiously Chain Smokin Appeared Very Animated. A Short Drums And He Got Up And Went On Stage And Started The Space. Brent Joined First Then Bobby All Sheepish Crept Out. Well a Furious Dew Insued And They Didn't Do Lost Sailor -> Saint Of Circumstance For A Long, Long Time If At All. And Folks That's The Way It Was. Honest John

reviews.title: rippin" sounds!!!!!!
reviews.body: This is a great setlist, well played and mixed. Vocals are soooo pure, and sound good. Wish I started catching em' a few years sooner('88)!!!!

reviews.title: Lots of Patches......
reviews.body: Lots of patches on this one,part of El Paso,all of Drums, and all of the Dew are all an audience patch,probably better off with the audience version of this one.Get the audience version just for the fact that this was the last Sailor/Saint with Garcia.Oh and the four stars isn't for the quality of this recording,but for the performance of the band.

reviews.title: Phil !
reviews.body: I think Phil sung "Box of Rain" Better in '86 than '87-'95.I like this version alot !Check out 9-17-70 for what could be the first "Box" ever.

reviews.title: bread crumb
reviews.body: The elephant in the room? One song after space? I'm pretty sure this is the only time that happened in this show format.
